We need to determine SMILES of an organic molecule given only "sample of an organic molecule" but no data. Likely we need to use measurement tools to get spectra. We have no description of spectra in prompt. So we must request measurements: mass spec, NMR, IR. Use minimal experiments. Probably start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then use NMR to deduce structure.

We need to decide which tool to call first. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra.
